study.question: Can sharing the action-aware residual scorer first layer retain the task-conditioned linear-moment improvement over g0 at lower measured cost, and does private routing still contribute after sharing? Does near-parent scorer capacity change that conclusion?
study.hypothesis: Observed starting point: g0-r0005-linear_moment macro AUC 0.8283262734957326, train 365.0393s, wall 406.3112s, 32948357 parameters. g3-r0006-linear_private reaches 0.8294419075559136, train 521.7611s, wall 570.1214s, 33059849 parameters; this is +0.0011156341 AUC at about +42.9% train time. The fully open comparison g3-r0007-linear_grad_open reaches 0.8294133370688469, train 527.5679s, wall 575.6412s. The round-6 linear/copy by private/mean factorial gives private-minus-mean +0.0003615708 with linear moments and +0.0005744612 with copy moments; interaction -0.0002128904. Thus there is preliminary controlled evidence of routing utility, but no positive synergy in that single-seed difference-in-differences. The four round-7 gradient cells span only 0.0000740808 macro AUC; the exact click-stop replay repeats the original score and is not an independent seed. Gradient isolation remains unsupported, not disproved. Mechanism hypothesis: much of the costly event-to-target nonlinear transformation is reusable across tasks; retaining independent second layers and readouts may preserve sufficient task-specific relevance while evaluating the largest first layer once. Keeping nonlinear independent heads, rather than four zero-initialized scalar heads on identical features, makes the mean-routing control an active multi-head network. This is a prospective cost/utility hypothesis, not an established mechanism or new originality claim. All eleven supplied trajectories succeeded; no failure or abandoned-branch receipts are supplied, so their scientific outcomes cannot be invented.

nearest_work.difference: Direct local architectural comparator. Replace four independent 400->64->32->1 action-aware residual scorers by one 400->H first layer plus four independent H->32->1 heads, H=64 or 210. Keep all shared moments, token interactions, readout widths and open input gradients. From-scratch training remains mandatory; this is not a checkpoint merge.

Retain the full g0 shared relation/count/moment representation and initial function. Add only the factorized residual task readout inherited conceptually from g3; compare cost and every task change to this stronger source, not just DIN.

Archived primary text lines 249-314 confirms target-dependent, unnormalized local activation sums. Inherit this primitive and its task-adapted implementation. The proposed shared residual trunk and task routing are local architectural adaptations; no claim to originate attention or exact DIN reproduction.

Pinned benchmark source lines 123-170 and 241-313 uses task-mask-initialized hubs and repeated aggregation/broadcast. This proposal uses a shared action-aware scorer trunk with private residual global summaries alongside an unchanged shared moment-token interaction. It adds no task-mask hubs or repeated broadcasts. The implementation is a benchmark reimplementation, not a verified equivalent of the original paper.

Primary benchmark section 2.3 describes task hubs, heterogeneous field transforms and unified attention. It supplies context, not local effectiveness or component attribution. No external benchmark number is transferred.

study.proposed_difference: Implement a single shared first residual scorer Linear(400,H)+Dice(H) once over each visible event/target interaction, then four separately initialized Linear(H,32)+Dice(32)+Linear(32,1) heads with zero output layers. Cross H=64 compact and H=210 near-parent-capacity widths with private versus task-independent mean routing; all four heads run in all cells. The two architecture switches are scorer_hidden_width and task_routing. Both old input-stop switches are explicitly false and true values are rejected because branch-specific input stops would require recomputing the shared trunk or would also stop its parameter gradients. Keep signed moments linear in every new cell and cite the existing round-6 representation-replacement factorial instead of rerunning it here. No data, labels, sample identity, history masks, loss, training hyperparameters or host-owned contracts change.
predictions: Primary utility prediction: compact_private exceeds g0 macro AUC under the same complete training exposure and reduces measured train/inference cost relative to g3-r0007-linear_grad_open. A numerical margin of 0.0002 AUC versus the full private source is an exploratory quality-retention diagnostic only; the frozen exact macro-AUC selection rule still chooses the incumbent unless a new cell wins.

At H=64, private-minus-mean macro AUC is positive if task-specific routing contributes beyond the same executed capacity; repeat confirmation is needed. At H=210 the same contrast checks whether routing value depends on trunk capacity.

If compact loses to the old source but capacity_private recovers at near-equal dense capacity, lost representational capacity or changed optimization becomes more plausible than an absolute need for fully private first layers. This is not a unique explanation.
The width-by-routing interaction, (capacity_private-capacity_mean)-(compact_private-compact_mean), tests capacity dependence; near zero does not establish absence of all interactions.

Forward outputs should initially match g0 in evaluation mode on identical inputs and inherited states; private/mean pairs should match initially at each width. After nonzero output weights, their independent head hidden states and gradients should be nonidentical. Empty histories must yield zero residual pools.

Static residual matrix MACs per event are estimated as 33920 compact versus 110720 for four original scorers and 111008 at width 210. This predicts a scorer-level compute reduction only; full-model wall-time speedup is unmeasured and may be much smaller.
falsifiers: No shared-trunk cell exceeds g0 on repeated paired validation, or improvement disappears when compared with its same-width mean control: no supported incremental task-conditioning utility for this implementation.
Compact_private loses meaningful AUC against the full scorer and has no measured train/inference benefit: reject the proposed quality/cost tradeoff, regardless of lower calculated MACs.

Near-capacity sharing fails while the full-private source remains better across paired seeds: shared features, capacity allocation or optimization may limit this construction; this does not refute all scorer sharing.
Mean routing matches or exceeds private routing on repeated comparisons: task-specific residual assignment is unsupported at that capacity, even if extra shared capacity improves g0.
Any future claimed gradient-isolation benefit must survive the already small round-7 stop contrasts and new discriminating evidence. The present change cannot establish gradient isolation.

Forward nonfiniteness, current-action/label sensitivity, padded-ID sensitivity, invalid empty-history residuals, missing scorer parameters in the optimizer, or inherited-state/RNG mismatch fails host readiness; retain any charged failure and correct before interpretation.
alternative_explanations: Added nonlinear capacity or action-aware residual input, rather than private routing, may explain most improvement over g0; same-width mean cells isolate assignment but not all effects of added capacity.

Sharing changes parameterization, Dice running statistics, gradient aggregation and initialization of new components together. Same-seed inherited states do not match new weights across different widths or against the old four-trunk model.

H=210 nearly matches parameter count and matrix MACs, but not activation memory, task-specific capacity allocation, normalization statistics or GPU efficiency. Its residual count exceeds the old source by 196 parameters, not zero.

One frozen training pass can favor different optimization speeds. Equal exposure isolates the architecture under this recipe; wall-time frontiers do not justify silently changing epochs or optimizers.

All available results use the same seed, and exact replay is deterministic reproduction rather than repeated support. Rare auxiliary positives and correlated users can make small AUC changes unstable.

The offline released histories can include delayed feedback not mature in production; category/brand auxiliary matching is not advertisement-specific conversion attribution. Relative rank moments are not real-time delays.

Original INFNet full-paper details and broader priority search remain unavailable or unverified in this registry scope. Standard shared-bottom task heads are inherited architectural practice, not a claimed invention.

The coding workspace contains source and accepted receipts, not raw parquet shards, torch or the training executor. Dataset-digest, numerical and performance reproduction cannot be rerun here; this is missing execution capability, not a failed scientific experiment.
